dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with EXEC SQL targeting ODBC/MSSQL Server and EXEC CICS; uses $SET compiler directive for SQL configuration (dbman=ODBC, TARGETDB=MSSQLSERVER, NOAUTOCOMMIT); pointer data type and binary usage consistent with Micro Focus

purpose.domain_detail: Automobile/vehicle service contract premium rating broker program for a company called CSO (Cowtown); handles webservices for premium rating, contract assignment, and dealer/account management
purpose.summary: SOCK08 is a CICS online broker program that acts as a webservices intermediary for insurance premium rating. It receives socket messages, processes rating requests for vehicle service contracts, interacts with a SQL Server database via ODBC, and returns rated premium data. It is version 2 of SOCK07, authored by PEMA for CSO.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with ODBC/MSSQL Server targeting via $SET directive
EXEC CICS for online transaction processing
Inline copybook content for ELCFUNDT and ELCDATE (date conversion)
Actuarial/mathematical variables (gamma, angle, temp-value series) suggesting premium calculation
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 1464 lines. Copybook content for ELCFUNDT and ELCDATE appears inlined rather than via COPY statements (copy_count=0 confirmed). The $SET directive is a Micro Focus compiler directive. Program appears to be a real production insurance rating system for a company called CSO.
